title: Two Toddlers Playing in Backyard Pool, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid mid-century black-and-white snapshot capturing two young children playing beside a small portable plastic wading pool in a sunny suburban backyard. A young boy stands shirtless wearing plaid shorts and carrying a small watering can, while a little girl in a striped swimsuit leans over to splash in the water. Dappled sunlight filters through nearby trees onto the grass, reflecting classic suburban family life during the postwar American baby boom era.
